acutechgroupinc-acutechgroupinc:greenhou.description: Who We Are: AcuTech Group, Inc. is a premier provider of process safety, risk management, chemical security, industrial fire protection engineering, and emergency management services. We have deep expertise in Process Safety Management (PSM), Training, Implementation, Auditing, Process Hazard Analyses (PHA’s), Hazard and Operability Studies (HAZOPs), Quantitative Risk Assessment (QRA) and Facility Siting, among other engineering and consulting services. AcuTech has deep specialization in the oil and gas, chemical, LNG, petrochemical, renewables, hydrogen, and other industries handling hazardous materials. Our industry experts deliver these services to leading privately held and publicly traded companies, as well as government agencies, and state sponsored entities globally. About the Job: We are currently seeking a Security Systems Engineer with in-depth expertise in SAIS/HCIS and RCU RIMA-compliant physical security systems. Based in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, the successful candidate will support a range of security engineering tasks across major infrastructure projects, including the design, documentation, construction supervision, and commissioning of integrated security and telecommunications systems. The role involves hands-on technical leadership, client interaction, and multidisciplinary collaboration across various sectors such as Oil & Gas, heritage sites, transportation, and critical infrastructure. What You’ll Do: As a Security Systems Engineer, you will lead the design, documentation, and implementation of integrated physical and electronic security systems aligned with SAIS/HCIS and RCU RIMA standards. You will be responsible for delivering engineering solutions across the full project lifecycle—from concept through commissioning—while providing technical leadership and supporting collaboration with clients, vendors, and internal teams. Key responsibilities include: Develop Concept, Preliminary, and Detailed Designs along with supporting drawings, documentation, and system specifications. Oversee construction supervision and commissioning of systems such as CCTV, IDAS, PIDS, SACS, ALPR, UVIS, VSS, VMS, PSIM, and related infrastructure. Respond to client technical queries and clarify design intent, integration requirements, and compliance standards. Create scopes of work, support tendering and evaluate technical and financial deliverables from third-party contractors. Utilize AutoCAD and/or MicroStation to produce or review detailed engineering drawings. Coordinate technical meetings with clients, consultants, and stakeholders to resolve design issues. Perform peer reviews of design packages to ensure quality, accuracy, and adherence to project requirements. Support documentation and administrative needs using cloud-based systems in line with company protocols. Participate in site visits and ensure technical alignment across all phases of project execution. What’s Required: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, preferably Electronics & Communications; an advanced degree is preferred. Strong experience with the design and implementation of integrated security systems and technologies aligned with SAIS/HCIS and RCU RIMA standards. Experience in industrial projects (Oil & Gas, Infrastructure, Historic Sites, Transport, etc.). Proficiency in AutoCAD and MS Office Suite; experience with MicroStation is preferred. Excellent knowledge of physical and electronic security technologies, including system integration. Strong understanding of project lifecycles including design, construction, commissioning, and close-out. Skilled in reviewing technical specifications and ensuring compliance with local and international standards. Strong communication, organizational, and analytical skills. Fluent in English (spoken, written, and read); Arabic is a plus. Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed and collaborate across time zones. alphapartners-baseten:ashbyhq:e47d18c5-7.description: ABOUT BASETEN Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to to ship AI products. THE ROLE As the Head of IT at Baseten, you will build, scale, and secure our internal technology function to support our rapid growth. Reporting to our Chief Information Security Officer, you will lead and mentor a team of 5+ IT engineers, leading the charge to transition Baseten from startup-era IT to a highly automated, enterprise-ready IT organization. You will take full ownership of corporate IT infrastructure, Helpdesk operations, corporate identity management, device lifecycles, and vendor procurement. As we scale to support the world’s most dynamic AI companies, you will ensure our internal systems scale seamlessly with our headcount, providing a secure, frictionless, and world-class technology experience for all Baseten employees. REQUIREMENTS - Experience: 5+ years of overall IT leadership experience, ideally accompanied by 2+ years of experience as a Head of IT or IT Director at an internet company, scaling developer-focused SaaS or AI infrastructure startups through rapid growth (e.g., 100 to 500+ employees). - Modern Cloud-Native Stack Mastery: Deep, hands-on expertise with Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), IAM/SSO (Okta, Google Workspace), MDM (Kandji, Jamf), and HRIS integrations (Rippling). - Vendor & Financial Discipline: A proven track record of successful vendor negotiations, complex hardware logistics, software license consolidation, and strict IT budget ownership. - AI-First Mindset: Proactive and forward-thinking approach to leveraging modern AI tooling and automation to eliminate operational friction, rather than relying on manual headcount expansion. - Process Engineering: Demonstrated ability to build enterprise-ready processes from the ground up, establish performance metrics, and drive continuous improvement in a fast-paced environment. farfetchlever-farfetch:lever:b8eafbbd-70.description: FARFETCH exists for the love of fashion. Our mission is to be the global platform for luxury fashion, connecting creators, curators and consumers. We're a positive platform for good, bringing together an incredible creative community made up by our people, our partners and our customers. This community is at the heart of our business success. We welcome differences, empower individuality and celebrate diverse skills and perspectives, creating an inclusive environment for everyone. We are FARFETCH for All. COMMERCIAL We're partnering with global brands and the most influential and renowned boutique curators to bring our customers an unrivalled range of fashion to empower their individuality. We’re relationship builders, we’re solution finders and we’re analysts. We work with all areas of the FARFETCH business to improve our social and environmental impact while delivering business success. We want to empower our consumers to buy better, improve our operational footprint, and explore new business models that improve our impact. LONDON Our office is located in Old Street, London's tech hub. Our open-plan space is ideal for collaborative working. When you're not doing what's never been done, you can enjoy a team lunch on our large outdoor terrace, or join a yoga class in our dedicated studio. THE ROLE The Commercial function at FARFETCH manages supply and pricing on the FARFETCH marketplace in order to drive profitable growth. Working across the business, we deliver at-scale commercial programmes which drive benefits for FARFETCH, our customers, and our partners. Reporting to the Head of Commercial - Pricing, you will lead cross-functional commercial strategy across global markets and partner with senior leadership on investment-style decisions shaping the business. Operating at the intersection of commercial strategy, data, and pricing, you will define the scope, own the roadmap, and drive high-impact projects. You will work seamlessly with leaders across Marketing, Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance, and Data Science to bring your strategic vision to life and optimize our positioning within key markets.
responsibilities: Drive Strategy & Insights: Lead the generation of high-level, action-driven insights. Present executive summaries to leadership to shape business strategy and proactively identify opportunities to optimize pricing and profitability on Farfetch.
Build Business Cases & Tools: Construct robust business cases, analytical frameworks, and tools that empower senior leadership to make sharper, data-backed commercial decisions.

Team Management & Development: Potential to manage direct reports and build a high-performing team, fostering a culture of operational excellence and continuous learning within the Commercial function.

Architect Solutions: Oversee the development of scalable tools, processes, and reporting frameworks (partnering with our BI and Product team) to continuously monitor our pricing position and mitigate risks across global markets.

Own End-to-End Projects: Direct and manage the full lifecycle of complex, cross-functional projects to improve our price position, securing buy-in and support from senior stakeholders across the business.
Senior Business Partnering: Act as the primary strategic partner and subject matter expert to a wide spectrum of key stakeholders, both in and out of the Commercial team.

Influence Partner Strategy: Guide the Brand Partnership, Business Development, and Account Management teams, providing them with the frameworks needed to successfully influence and optimize the pricing strategies of our boutique and brand partners.

Guide Merchandising & Finance: Collaborate with Merchandising to translate complex data into actionable trading decisions, and partner with Finance to validate forecasting models, ensuring business targets are met.
Product Development: Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to define and implement a robust feature roadmap that empowers our Partners to effectively manage their pricing on the platform.

This is a high-impact product leadership role focused on building and scaling a modern content engine within a growing healthcare education organization. You will own the strategy, roadmap, and evolution of platforms supporting content generation, accredited learning, publications, and clinical tools. Identify and develop new content products, formats, tools, and data capabilities that create value for healthcare professionals and commercial partners. Establish measurable accountability for content accuracy, metadata quality, operational scalability, product delivery, and expansion into additional specialty markets. This is a senior, commercially minded marketing leadership role focused on turning brand awareness into measurable revenue and scalable growth. You will own the full marketing strategy across acquisition, conversion, retention, lifecycle, brand, content, and community. As a player-coach, you will lead the Marketing team while staying close to performance data, creative execution, and optimization. You will work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to support growth and expansion into new markets. This is an opportunity for a bold, data-driven leader who knows how to build a memorable brand while delivering strong commercial results. Own and evolve the overall marketing strategy across growth, lifecycle, brand, content, and community, translating company growth and revenue objectives into clear priorities, budgets, KPIs, and measurable outcomes. Lead marketing analytics and reporting, maintaining clear visibility into channel performance, customer behavior, acquisition, conversion, retention, and lifetime value. Develop a deep understanding of target customers and use behavioral insights to improve the full customer journey from discovery through purchase, repeat visits, and advocacy. Own profitable customer acquisition and ticket sales across markets, overseeing paid media, SEO, and other growth channels while driving continuous testing and optimization of CAC, ROAS, conversion, and LTV. Oversee e-commerce and digital conversion performance, including landing pages, offers, booking journeys, mobile experiences, and checkout. Build repeatable marketing playbooks for launching and scaling new locations, working closely with Operations to align marketing investment with ticket inventory, seasonality, and market performance. Identify and test new channels, audiences, offers, partnerships, and creative concepts to unlock additional growth opportunities. You’ll collaborate closely with engineers across platforms, product managers, designers, data scientists, and backend teams to identify high-impact opportunities, run experiments, and ship high-quality, performant mobile experiences. If you’re excited by the challenge of helping millions of people connect meaningfully—and you love crafting intuitive, elegant apps—we’d love to hear from you.

southparkcommons-boom-supersonic:ripplin.title: Talent Coordinator
southparkcommons-boom-supersonic:ripplin.description: Denver, CO · Full-time Boom Supersonic is building the breakthrough Overture supersonic airliner and the Superpower natural gas turbine—machines that push the boundaries of physics, manufacturing, and industrial ambition. But extraordinary companies are built not just on engineering talent, but on how they treat people—especially the ones considering joining. That’s where you come in. Not a traditional coordinator role As a Talent Coordinator, you won’t manage calendars, you’ll shape the candidate journey and set the tone for what it means to engage with Boom. Working alongside a small, high-performance recruiting team, you’ll help design and run the hiring process for engineers, manufacturing leaders, and other critical hires who will shape the company’s future. You’ll be part of a small, high-performance recruiting team responsible for building one of the most ambitious hardware companies of this century. Every engineer, every manufacturing leader, every critical hire will move through a process you help design and operate. At Boom, coordination is strategic, and you’ll ensure every candidate’s first experience reflects the ambition and excellence of what we’re building. You’ll be the person who ensures that a candidate’s first in-person experience matches the ambition of the machines we’re building. The mission We’re scaling rapidly—particularly across engineering and manufacturing. That means, complex interview loops, travel from around the country, and tight coordination between recruiters, hiring managers, and executives. You will: own scheduling for virtual and on-site interviews, coordinate candidate travel seamlessly, host candidates and guide them through their day, ensure interviewers are well-prepared, maintain pristine data hygiene in our ATS, and anticipate and solve problems before they arise. Expect to be stretched and wear multiple hats: you’ll also be owning projects in addition to coordination, such as improving templates, organizing events along with marketing, etc. You’ll work in close partnership with recruiters who are doing the sourcing and closing work—and selling candidates (even those we end up turning down) is part of everyone’s job. This job is demanding and rewarding The margin for error is low. Attention to detail is non-negotiable. You will manage dozens of moving pieces simultaneously. You’ll need to be structured, proactive, and calm under pressure. You’ll interface with executives, senior engineers, and candidates evaluating life-changing career decisions. If you’re looking for a passive coordination role where “good enough” works, this isn’t it. If you take pride in flawless execution and creating experiences that people remember, keep reading. The primary reward is ownership: you will shape how the world’s top talent experiences Boom. You’ll be well compensated with competitive cash and meaningful equity. More importantly, you’ll build the team that builds history. If that excites you, click apply and let us know why you’re excited. Compensation The Base Salary Range for this position is $73,000 - $93,000 per year. Actual salaries will vary based on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Boom’s total rewards package for employees. Other rewards may include long-term incentives/equity, a flexible PTO policy, and many other progressive benefits. There is no set deadline to apply for this job opportunity. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the search is no longer active. ITAR Requirement To conform to U.S. Government aerospace technology export regulations (ITAR and EAR), applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State . Learn more about ITAR here. Boom is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity. All employment is decide
